Momino Yeh Hai Janaza Abid-e-Beemar Ka.
Jo Kabhi Bhola Na Manzar Sham Ke Bazar Ka.

1
Dhop Thi Our Pyas Thi Our Taziyana Tha Giza.
Khoon Bhi Jari Jism Se Tha Shah Ke Dildar Ka.
Di Sada Zainab Ne Baba Ko Laeeno Ne Keh Jab.
Pusht Se Khaincha Tha Bistar Abid-e- Beemar Ka.

2
Maa Phophi Behnein Khari Thin Be Rida Bazar Mein.
Tha Ajab Yeh Imtehaan Oss Qafila Salar Ka.
Bar Sar-e-Mehfil Taruf Bibiyon Ka Jab Howa.
Sharam Se Sar Jhuk Gaya Oss Bekas-o-La Char Ka.

3
Kuch Nahi Parwah Sataish Ki Baroz-e-Hashar Hi.
Dein Gay Maula Khud Sila Mujh Ko Mere Ashar Ka.
Ab Dua Yeh Hai Shajeeha Ki Imam-e-Asar Se.
Silsila Jari Rahe Afkar Ke Izhar Ka.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/momino-yeh-hai-janaza-abid-e-beemar-ka-tajpoints-6304065ab8b5e6be3b4f.md')
_, metadata, source = p.read_text().split('---\\n', 2)
roman = metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (source, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    lines = [[line.strip() for line in block.splitlines()] for block in blocks]
    assert [len(block) for block in lines] == [2, 5, 5, 5]
    assert [block[0] for block in lines[1:]] == list(numbers)
assert '\\u200c' not in source
assert 'noUrdu' not in metadata
print('Verified 14 verses in each edition, with a two-verse opening and three four-verse stanzas.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and moved the Roman transcription into `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have the same two-verse opening and three four-verse stanzas. Set the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, kept the Roman alternate title, and removed `noUrdu`.

I retained the unusual “keh jab” wording as `کہہ جب` and rendered the takhallus “Shajeeha” as `شجیحہ`.
